title: Joseph U NDE 22053
content: As I fell and my friend fell on me I blacked out. At this time, I looked down on myself lying there with my friends around me. I could hear what they were saying and what was going on. I heard the TV and the commercials and I was watching. I felt myself kind of floating above them near the ceiling and I could see down the hallway. I was able to see my friends who were in the hallway. I could see what they were doing. I don't believe I was dead, but I could hear my friends discussing their worries that I was unconscious. They were slapping my face. One friend went to get water to splash on me. We were young and they didn't know what to do to revive me. As soon as I saw them about to splash water on me, I felt myself being pulled back into my body. I awoke and was a little confused what had happened to me. As I started to feel better, I started to ask them questions about what they were saying and to my surprise, it was accurate. Then I went down the hallway, found my friends, and asked them if what I saw them doing, was the truth. They both confirmed that they were playing with a ball and throwing it back and forth. I was shocked and so was everyone else. They all just shrugged it off as that I was playing a joke on them. Or I had been unconscious but had heard them. But I knew that I had felt like I was floating and had felt like I saw them from the ceiling. I never really tried to go any further with anyone that night but I always knew that I had and out of body experience. Then one night I heard a show on coast to coast and decided to write my story here. Ever since this experience, I have had strong feelings that there is life after death and that our bodies are just vessels. I have changed in the way of attitude. Before this event, I was always getting into fights and arguing with anyone and everyone. After this experience, I have been a lot happier and know that there is something more than this plane of reality. I even have grown a lot more spiritual and religion has fascinated me. I think that before this experience I was afraid of death and of little things. This experience didn't frighten me it made me get a sense of how wonderful life is and how much we have to learn on this plane of existence.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Blacked out after falling when a friend fell on him.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Immediate out-of-body perception in the room (ceiling vantage, seeing down the hallway) followed by being pulled back into the body when friends were about to splash water on him; no tunnel/light/life review described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Observed and later verified contemporaneous sounds (TV/commercials) and friends' actions in another area (down the hallway) while unconscious; return triggered by seeing water about to be splashed.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I looked down on myself lying there with my friends around me.” “I felt myself kind of floating above them near the ceiling and I could see down the hallway.” “As soon as I saw them about to splash water on me, I felt myself being pulled back into my body.”
